subject: Request: Annotation Scholarship + Trial Top-up for OpenArchive Research Collective
messages:
From: Dr. Elena Kuznetsov <elena.k@openarchive.org>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: research-admin@openarchive.org
Date: 2026-10-30 09:12 -0400
Subject: Request: short trial extension + annotation stipend

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the introductory demo last week. OpenArchive is running a small student-annotator project to produce human-reviewed labels for a public-language dataset (non-commercial). We began the trial you provided, and we’re seeing much higher token consumption than we anticipated because the annotators are using iterative prompting to converge on label conventions.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider a one-time trial top-up of 150k tokens and a small stipend allocation to cover 5 undergraduate annotators (~$1,000 each) to pay for their time? The stipend would be paid externally to the students by our institution — we only need the compute/credits for the LLM calls.

Attached: OA_project_summary.pdf and annotator-budget.xlsx.

If this is the wrong team, please point me to the right contact. Happy to provide short usage logs and a brief impact statement for our funding office.

Best,
Elena
Dr. Elena Kuznetsov
Lead, Data Curation — OpenArchive Research Collective
elena.k@openarchive.org

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30 11:06 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Request: short trial extension + annotation stipend

Ben / Marissa — forwarding an edu request. Summary: OpenArchive (nonprofit, EU) needs +150k trial tokens for an annotation pilot and asks if we can authorize a stipend-linked credit top-up. They’re clearly academic and public-interest; attached SOW and budget.

Key questions for approvals:
- Can we provision 150k tokens as a one-time grant under the edu/pilot program?
- Any concerns about stipend language? (we won’t be paying students, just providing compute credits)
- If ok, do we route through a draft MAP credit addendum (attached) and include a mild usage cap?

Estimated unit impact at our hosted pricing: rough token value ~$450 (prod-equivalent) — let me know if we prefer instead to offer a promo code covering the equivalent compute dollar amount.

I’ve included the attachments from the PI. If you want a quick call I can loop Elena.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Developer Partnerships | Redwood Inference
——

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30 12:45 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short trial extension + annotation stipend

Sofia — looks aligned with our EDU pilot intent. Approve 150k token grant provisionally. Two asks:
1) Add a 30-day usage window tied to the grant so credits don’t linger.
2) Marissa / Finance to sign off on the notional dollar exposure — I suggest a promo-code issuance for transparency (vs altering billing entries).

Marissa — can you confirm finance/legal ok with the stipend wording (we must not be seen as contracting labor). If they’re only asking for compute tokens we’re fine.

-Ben
Senior Partnerships Manager

To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01 09:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short trial extension + annotation stipend

Thanks — finance is fine with a 150k token promo code capped to a 30-day redemption window. Legal asked for:
- An addendum that clarifies credits are for compute only and not payment to third parties.
- An export/data-retention note (OpenArchive is EU-based — verify retention settings & region of serving).

I’ve drafted a short MAP credit addendum (draft-MAP-credit-addendum.pdf) and updated the HubSpot deal with DEAL-78934. I’ll finalize once Sofia confirms we’ll use a promo code + addendum route.

Hi Elena — good news: we can provide a one-time 150k-token promo code for OpenArchive tied to a 30-day redemption window. Legal asked that we sign a short addendum confirming credits are compute-only (not payment to individuals) and documenting region/retention guardrails. I’ve attached the draft addendum for your review (draft-MAP-credit-addendum.pdf).

Next steps:
- If you agree to the addendum terms, I'll send a DocuSign link for signature and then the promo code (and expiration date).
- Please confirm the preferred serving region (eu-west-1 or eu-central) and whether you need extended retention settings for artifact logs — we can enable a 90-day retention for trial activity if necessary.

If everything looks good, we’ll aim to have the code issued within 48 hours of sign-off.

Attachments: draft-MAP-credit-addendum.pdf
